title: CV Studio selector and preview reliability
steps: Reproduce select options being destroyed by busy() before loading job/variant values
Keep select content/value intact, capture selected values before async work, and avoid marking selection changes as unsaved edits
Render explicit preview empty/loading/error states and preserve job/version selection across CV tabs
Adopt readable in-workspace legacy CVs into version history without replacing existing files or job/profile data
Verify actual job/version/variant selection in Playwright, failed/empty previews, and required agent verification
